# Hospitals

This folder catalogs the individual hospitals and hospital groups across Denmark that participate in the national Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) quality monitoring program. The pages detail each institution's performance on clinical process and outcome indicators—such as early antibiotic administration, epidural pain management, and 30-day postoperative mortality stratified by the Charlson Comorbidity Index. Beyond raw compliance metrics, these entity pages capture inter-hospital variations, data quality anomalies at low-volume units, and active methodological critiques submitted by hospital staff to the national registry.

## Pages

- [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|"Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted"]] — Department showing 0.0% fulfillment across all AKDB indicators, suggesting an absence of eligible acute surgery cases.
- [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] — Major Region Nordjylland hospital tracking early antibiotic compliance and 30-day mortality stratified by Charlson Score.
- [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] — Region Midtjylland hospital achieving high compliance for early antibiotic treatment and detailed comorbidity-stratified mortality tracking.
- [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] — Capital Region hospital notable for having the highest national rate of epidural catheter placement for acute surgical pain management.
- [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]] — Capital Region entity that achieved the highest national compliance for early antibiotic treatment in the 2022-2023 reporting period.
- [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] — Hospital with the highest national compliance for early antibiotic treatment in 2022-2023, despite a noted regional classification discrepancy in the database.
- [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] — Region Syddanmark hospital complex meeting the national standard for epidural administration during acute surgery.
- [[esbjerg-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus]] — Region Syddanmark hospital grouped with Grindsted for AKDB reporting, showing an 18.2% compliance rate for early antibiotic treatment.
- [[herlev-og-gentofte-hospital|Herlev og Gentofte Hospital]] — Capital Region hospital tracking process indicators and 30-day mortality, contributing to the regional aggregate metrics.
- [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]] — Region Sjælland hospital highlighted as a best-practice example for improving preoperative optimization through cultural workflow changes.
- [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]] — Hospital unit tracked across both Region Hovedstaden and Region Sjælland, monitoring antibiotic timing and surgical intervention speed.
- [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] — Region Midtjylland hospital unit evaluated on early antibiotic treatment and comorbidity-stratified 30-day mortality.
- [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] — Region Syddanmark hospital referenced for supplementary cancer disease distribution data among acute surgical patients.
- [[naestved-slagese-og-ringsted-sygehuse|"Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse"]] — Region Sjælland hospital group highlighting inter-hospital variation with a notably low epidural catheter placement rate.
- [[nykoebing-f-sygehus|Nykøbing F Sygehus]] — Region Sjælland hospital exhibiting extreme statistical uncertainty and invalid data flags due to very low acute surgery patient volumes.
- [[odense-universitetshospital-svendborg|Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]] — Region Syddanmark hospital recording the lowest national compliance for early antibiotic treatment in the 2022-2023 period.
- [[ouh-odense-universitetshospital-odense|OUH Odense Universitetshospital (Odense)]] — Primary Odense department providing supplementary cancer distribution and demographic data for national benchmarking.
- [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] — Region Nordjylland hospital that actively audits and critiques AKDB methodology, questioning Charlson Score calculations and indicator definitions.
- [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] — Region Midtjylland hospital meeting the standard for epidural administration and tracking comorbidity-stratified mortality.
- [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] — Region Midtjylland hospital meeting the standard for epidural administration and reporting demographic and cancer comorbidity data.
- [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] — Region Midtjylland hospital showing notable improvement in early antibiotic treatment and proposing the removal of Indikator 9 due to administrative burden.
- [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] — Major Capital Region hospital recording the lowest national fulfillment for early antibiotic treatment and early nutritional assessment in 2022-2023.
- [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-koege|"Sjællands Universitetshospital, Køge"]] — Hospital department contributing supplementary cancer diagnosis data for risk-adjusting 90-day postoperative mortality.
- [[sjaellands-universitetshospital|Sjællands Universitetshospital]] — Region Sjælland hospital evaluated on antibiotic timing, nutritional assessment, and comorbidity-stratified mortality.
- [[slagelse|Slagelse]] — Region Sjælland hospital contributing cancer distribution data to adjust for comorbidities in 90-day mortality assessments.
- [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]] — Region Syddanmark hospital tracking early antibiotic compliance and 30-day mortality stratified by the Charlson Comorbidity Index.
- [[sygehus-soenderjylland|Sygehus Sønderjylland]] — Region Syddanmark hospital monitored for early antibiotic administration and comorbidity-stratified postoperative mortality.
- [[vejle-sygehus|Vejle Sygehus]] — Region Syddanmark hospital providing hospital-level cancer diagnosis distribution data to support risk adjustment for 90-day mortality indicators.
